answer: Written in a pragmatic engineering perspective, trade-offs first register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on time-locked escrow with arbitration fallback. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A kernel of per-task receipts records who did what, and the anchor of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
